plan: Model items as a recursively traversed tree of container and leaf dictionaries.
Centralize traversal, lookup, note parsing, and container validation in private helpers.
Validate every move completely before mutating either item list, ensuring failed moves are atomic.
Return deep copies at construction and serialization boundaries.
mechanisms: Recursive depth-first traversal for aggregation, marker collection, outline rendering, and identifier lookup.
Kind-specific summary logic: notes derive words and markers from text; references use declared word counts and unresolved lists.
Pre-mutation containment, cycle, identifier, and insertion-index validation.
Deep-copy isolation for input data and `to_data()` output.

trace.source_relation: recursive part-whole nesting and uniform operations across parcel/crate levels
trace.target_mechanism: Recursive depth-first traversal shared by aggregation, marker collection, outline rendering, and lookup.
